name: mail
description: Represents email or message composition. On hover the envelope flap lifts upward (morphing to a peak above the rim) and a letter rises into view inside the interior. Closes on hover-leave.

animation.description: Flap paths share identical M-L-L command structures for smooth coordinate interpolation (closed V to open peak, 0.35s cubic-bezier 0.65/0/0.35/1). The letter lines are anchored at their opened position inside the interior and rise up from below with a fade, keeping them clear of the envelope walls at all times. Reverses on hover-leave.

accessibility.notes: When used as a link to an inbox or compose flow, the parent element should provide destination context.
